map.由物镜/目镜焦距、光学筒长与明视距离，按 M = (L/f₀)(D/fₑ) 计算: From the objective/eyepiece focal lengths, the optical tube length and the near point distance, compute the total magnification using M = (L/f₀)(D/fₑ).
map.📖 查看「复式显微镜总放大率 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Compound Microscope Total Magnification User Guide"
map.筒长 L 为物镜后焦面到目镜前焦面的距离（标准 160mm）。: The tube length L is the distance from the objective's back focal plane to the eyepiece's front focal plane (standard 160mm).
map.明视距离 D 通常取 250mm。: The near point distance D is usually taken as 250mm.
map.由物镜/目镜焦距与镜筒长算总放大。: From the objective/eyepiece focal lengths and the tube length, compute the total magnification.
map.选物镜倍数配目镜。: Choose the objective magnification to match the eyepiece.
map.有效放大受分辨率限。: Effective magnification is limited by resolution.
map.镜筒长 L=16cm、物镜 f_o=1cm、目镜 f_e=2.5cm → M=(: Tube length L=16cm, objective f_o=1cm, eyepiece f_e=2.5cm → M=(16/1)×(25/2.5)=16×10=160× (25cm is the near point distance).
map.油镜 NA=1.4 有效放大≈1000×NA=1400×；盲目加到 2000×: An oil objective with NA=1.4 has an effective magnification of ≈1000×NA=1400×; blindly pushing to 2000× only shows blur without adding detail (empty magnification).
map.否。超过分辨率对应的有效放大（≈1000×NA）即空放大，细节不增反乱。: No. Beyond the effective magnification corresponding to the resolution (≈1000×NA) it becomes empty magnification, and detail gets noisier rather than clearer.
map.物镜倍数怎么选？: How to choose the objective magnification?
map.先低倍找视野再高倍，油镜(100×)需浸油提 NA，干用分辨率骤降。: Start at low power to find the field then switch to high power; a 100× oil objective needs oil immersion to raise NA, and using it dry drops the resolution sharply.
